newsitem.title: UK: UK generators bounce back in mixed London market.
newsitem.headline: UK generators bounce back in mixed London market.

text.p: Shares in National Power and PowerGen continued their recent rise on Thursday, shrugging off an otherwise mixed performance from blue-chip stocks in London, traders said.
National Power added 101-/2p to 404p and PowerGen 14-1/2p to 506-1/2p after upbeat broker comments over the past two weeks.
UBS issued a positive note earlier this week, said dealers, and Goldman Sachs repeated its "market outperform" rating on the stocks last week.
"Both of these stocks have bottomed out. They really have taken everything, including windfall taxes, on board in their share prices," said one senior trader.
"They've got way oversold but the momentum behind it is the UBS buy note and maybe speculation of a bid from Shell for one of them."
